fusions.name: Split Feed
fusions.desc: Sends a snap of water that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then branches to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the damage. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Two Currents
fusions.desc: A raking pass that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles of you and leaves them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Other Flank
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to call a circling double that fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Second Prong
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a strike forks to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 3 seconds.
